name: Symmetry Wallpaper
desc: A seeded harmonic motif replicated under the plane symmetry groups — mirrors, glides, 2/4/6-fold rotations — folding an ornate seamless kaleidoscopic wallpaper that drifts continuously and morphs its symmetry every section, rendered as jewel-facet ornament, gold Islamic star lattice, leaded art-nouveau glass, neon psychedelia, or two-tone woodblock.

cells.doc: number of unit cells across the frame (tile count)

warp.doc: organic domain-warp bending of the lattice

group.doc: plane symmetry group ('auto' cycles on section)
